private_lines.Maya: You work nights as a paramedic out of the Hexham ambulance station, and this week you're covering a run of twelve-hour shifts while a colleague is off with a broken wrist, so your sleep is patchy and your days are short on time.
private_lines.Tom: You run a small cabinet-making workshop on an industrial estate outside Corbridge, and you're finishing a commission for a church pew restoration that has you there until late every evening, with sawdust in everything you own.
private_lines.Jo: You live in Leeds, where you teach secondary geography, and this week you're marking mock exam papers while juggling a parents' evening on Thursday and a flat that has a dripping tap your landlord keeps promising to fix.

setting: You all grew up in Hexham, a market town in Northumberland, and you're siblings whose parents still live a few streets from the house where you were raised.
